summary: Morgan County, TN CCC-era steel fire tower on Frozen Head, replaced by a summit observation deck in 2006. Sources differ on the build timing.

facts.design: Steel lookout tower erected by the Civilian Conservation Corps
facts.status_note: Fire tower replaced in 2006 by an observation deck at the summit; the deck is what stands today.

access.note: State natural area; hiking is the main recreation.

visit.trail_note: A main tower trail, with a short spur to a rock shelter near the summit (per Wikipedia).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives c.1933 for the steel tower. Wikipedia says a CCC camp inside the forest did not start until 1938. The personal-site history says the tower followed the camp. The tower date is approximate.
Forest Lookouts says the tower was dismantled; Wikipedia and Tennessee Landforms say replaced. All agree an observation deck took its place in 2006.

notes_for_editor: Replacement in 2006 is supported by three sources. The c.1933 build year comes from Forest Lookouts alone, and the CCC camp date conflicts (1933 vs 1938). The personal-site history is secondary. The record's status gone still fits; a status_note was added because the summit now has an observation deck. Record height_m is null and no measured height was found. No sources on staffing or fires for this tower were found. The record's existing photo is from easternuslookouts and is not a new find.
